subject: Focus decision: Alpha3 opening WakeInner lifetime vs ordered-batch generation
body: Discovery/gap gate complete against 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70. Selected C1 score=27: opening inner-wake action lifetime across ordered hinge batching. Current FoldOverlayService replays every accepted sample in a main-thread batch. Fold7ContinuityController emits WakeInner on NATIVE_COVER→OPENING_FROM_CLOSED, then increments generation again on OPENING_FROM_CLOSED→INNER_HANDOFF. Fold7ContinuityCoordinator.wakeInner launches Dispatchers.IO and re-checks controller generation before Binder wake. Therefore [3.2°,8.2°] or [15°,15.5°] can advance generation before IO starts and suppress the still-required wake. Boundary excludes overflow recovery, source-switch semantics, sensor access, restart leases, and presentation readiness. Cheapest decisive test: deterministic delayed-IO schedule model.
